``` r
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in ACC to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
```

``` r
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

``` r
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just brain
origdb_allbrain_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "BRAIN") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allbrain_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "BRAIN") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with brain in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
brain_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allbrain_mult_pts)
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                           summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                              orderBy = "calculation", 
                                              sortOrder = "desc")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                           orderBy = "calculation", 
                                           sortOrder = "desc")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
brain_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- brain_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,
                         " (", 
                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Age),
                         Age)) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

``` r
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in brain to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
```

``` r
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just osteosarcoma
origdb_allosteosarcoma_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Osteosarcoma") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allosteosarcoma_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Osteosarcoma") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with osteosarcoma in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allosteosarcoma_mult_pts)
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                                  summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                     orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                     sortOrder = "desc")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                  orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                  sortOrder = "desc")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,
                         " (", 
                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Age),
                         Age)) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

``` r
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in osteosarcoma to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
```

``` r
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
```

``` r
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just soft tissues
origdb_allsofttissues_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "SOFT TISSUES") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allsofttissues_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "SOFT TISSUES") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with softtissues in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allsofttissues_mult_pts)
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                                 summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                    orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                    sortOrder = "desc")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                 orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                 sortOrder = "desc")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,
                         " (", 
                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals",

                         Age)) %>%

# divide number of female and male pts by total number of pts per age stratum

  mutate_at(vars(2:Total), 
            .funs = ~./Total) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Female = `F`,
                Male = M)

  mutate_at(vars(2:Total),

                Male = M)

# divide vertically down sex columns to calc proportions of each mut type in each sex, add number of total female and male pts to colnames

  dplyr::select(-Total) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_type_pivot[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_type_pivot), "F"])) %>% 
  transform(Male = `M`/as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_type_pivot[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_type_pivot), "M"]))

# create pivot of mutated residues vs sex in all softtissues patients, replace NA with 0, arrange by increasing codon number, add row and column totals
softtissues_mult_sex_pos <- PivotTable$new()
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$addData(origdb_allsofttissues_mult_pts)
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription")
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                           summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                              orderBy = "calculation", 
                                              sortOrder = "desc")
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                           orderBy = "calculation", 
                                           sortOrder = "desc")
softtissues_mult_sex_pos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot <- softtissues_mult_sex_pos$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  arrange(abs(parse_number(ProtDescription))) %>% # arrange muts by increasing codon number
  dplyr::rename(Num_Individuals = Total,
                Mutation = ProtDescription,
                Female = `F`,
                Male = M) %>%
  remove_rownames()

softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc <- softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage %>%
  transform(`F` = as.numeric(Female)/as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"])) %>%
  transform(`M` = as.numeric(Male)/as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"])) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Mutation,
                  `F`,
                  `M`)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% unique(as.vector(multcancerpivotpos_melted_over0.01$Mutation)))

  transform(`30 - 39` = as.numeric(as.numeric(softtissues_mult_agestrata_pos_pivot_damage[,4]))/as.numeric(softtissues_mult_agestrata_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_agestrata_pos_pivot_damage),

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

``` r
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in soft tissues to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
```

<img src="figures/distribution-cutoff-softtissues-sole-agestrata-pos-1.svg" width="100%" height="100%" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

``` r
mut_rescued_hematological_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                                                   subset(Short_topo == "HEMATOP. SYSTEM") %>%
                                                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                                 Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>% 
                                                   dplyr::select(c(Short_topo,
                                                                   Morphology,
                                                                   #Population, 
                                                                   #Region,
                                                                   Sex,
                                                                   Age_stratum,
                                                                   Effect,
                                                                   ProtDescription,
                                                                   Domain,
                                                                   Residue_function,
                                                                   SIFTClass,
                                                                   DNE_LOFclass)) %>% 
                                                   arrange(abs(parse_number(ProtDescription))) %>% 
                                                   arrange(Morphology) %>% 
                                                   # mutate(ProtDescription = gsub("\\?-0-splice",
                                                   #                               "Intronic",
                                                   #                               ProtDescription)) %>% 
                                                   # mutate(ProtDescription = gsub("\\?",
                                                   #                               "",
                                                   #                               ProtDescription)) %>%
                                                   mutate(across(everything(), 
                                                                 ~ replace(., 
                                                                           . %in% c("NA", NA),
                                                                           ""))) %>% 
                                                   dplyr::rename(System = Short_topo,
                                                                 Cancer = Morphology,
                                                                 `Age stratum` = Age_stratum,
                                                                 Type = Effect,
                                                                 Mutation = ProtDescription,
                                                                 `Feature` = Residue_function,
                                                                 `SIFT` = SIFTClass,
                                                                 `DNE` = DNE_LOFclass) %>% 
                                                   remove_rownames()) %>% 
  rule_text_color(Mutation,
                  ifelse(Mutation %in% mut_rescued,
                         "red",
                         "")) %>%
  rule_text_bold(Mutation,
                 expression = Mutation %in% mut_rescued) %>%
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

mut_rescued_hematological_grid <- grid.arrange(mut_rescued_hematological_gridprep,
                                               top = textGrob("Individuals with Hematological Cancers and Germline TP53 Mutations",
                                                              hjust = 0.5,
                                                              gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
soleotherpivotage_gridprep <- condformat(soleotherpivotage %>%
                                           mutate(across(everything(),

                                                                   . %in% c("NA", NA),

                                           relocate(colnames(.)[c(6,4,5,3,2)], # make ages ascending 
                                                    .after = Short_topo) %>%
                                           dplyr::rename(System = Short_topo) %>%
                                           remove_rownames()) %>%
  rule_text_bold(Total,
                 expression = Total > 0) %>%
  # rule_fill_discrete(Total,
  #                    expression = Total > 0,
  #                    colours = c("TRUE" = "grey80")) %>% # also adds unremovable black borders
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm"),
                                                fg_params = list(fontface = c(rep("plain", 
                                                                                  nrow(soleotherpivotage) - 1), 
                                                                              "bold")),
                                                bg_params = list(fill = c(rep(c("grey95", "grey90"),
                                                                              length.out = (nrow(soleotherpivotage) - 1)),
                                                                          "grey80")))
             )) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)
```

$~$

Now that proportions have been calculated, I can visualize them with a few types of plots. Here, I have created 100% stacked barcharts of mutation categories across the 5 cancers or in those without cancer, ages, and sexes, and have saved the plots as SVG files.

``` r
#sort cancers by lowest to highest missense mutation or breast proportion for stacked barchart
solecancerbarchartorder = solecancerpivottype_melted[solecancerpivottype_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label = factor(solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label, 
                                                 levels = solecancerbarchartorder$Cancer_Label[order(solecancerbarchartorder$Proportion)])

solecancerbarchartorder_age = solecancerpivotage_type_melted[solecancerpivotage_type_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
solecancerpivotage_type_melted$Age = factor(solecancerpivotage_type_melted$Age, 
                                            levels = solecancerbarchartorder_age$Age[order(solecancerbarchartorder_age$Proportion)])

# solecancerbarchartorder_age_tissue = solecancerpivotage_melted[solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label == 'BREAST',]
# solecancerpivotage_melted$Age = factor(solecancerpivotage_melted$Age, 
#                                        levels = solecancerbarchartorder_age_tissue$Age[order(solecancerbarchartorder_age_tissue$Proportion)])

solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label <- factor(solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label,
                                                 levels = as.character(c((sort(unique(solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label)))[(sort(unique(solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label))) != "OTHER"], 
                                                                         "OTHER")))

solecancerbarchartorder_sex = solecancerpivotsex_type_melted[solecancerpivotsex_type_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
solecancerpivotsex_type_melted$Sex = factor(solecancerpivotsex_type_melted$Sex, 
                                            levels = solecancerbarchartorder_sex$Sex[order(solecancerbarchartorder_sex$Proportion)])

# solecancerbarchartorder_sex_tissue = solecancerpivotsex_melted[solecancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label == 'BREAST',]
# solecancerpivotsex_melted$Sex = factor(solecancerpivotsex_melted$Sex, 
#                                        levels = solecancerbarchartorder_sex_tissue$Sex[order(solecancerbarchartorder_sex_tissue$Proportion)])

solecancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label <- factor(solecancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label,
                                                 levels = as.character(c((sort(unique(solecancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label)))[(sort(unique(solecancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label))) != "OTHER"], 
                                                                         "OTHER")))

# make 100% stacked barchart with ggplot2 with reversed missense order i.e. highest to lowest
solecancer_ggplotstackedbarchart <- ggplot(solecancerpivottype_melted %>%
                                             subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                                "OTHER")), 
                                           aes(x = Cancer_Label, 
                                               y = Proportion, 
                                               fill = Mutation)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Mutation Types vs. Cancers of \nIndividuals with One Cancer \nand Germline p53 Mutations") + # distinct individuals/ \n# total distinct individuals
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label)[!str_detect(levels(solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label), 
                                                                                            "OTHER")]), 
                   expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#009E73",
                               "#000000",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#CC79A7",
                               "#999999",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "lightgray",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#D55E00",
                               "#F0E442")) +   
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        # plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,8, "mm"))
solecancer_ggplotstackedbarchart
```

``` r
# to minimize above crowding, make faceted barchart of age vs number of pts per cancer
barchart_facet_age_tissue_sole <- ggplot(solecancerpivotage %>%
                                           subset(Age_stratum != "Total") %>%
                                           mutate(Age_stratum = paste0(Age_stratum,
                                                                       " (",
                                                                       format(Total, 
                                                                              big.mark = ",", 
                                                                              trim = TRUE),
                                                                       " individuals)")) %>%
                                           dplyr::select(-c(Total
                                                            #,
                                                            #OTHER
                                           )) %>% 
                                           mutate(across(everything(), 
                                                         ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
                                           reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                           dplyr::rename(Age = Age_stratum,
                                                         Cancer = variable, 
                                                         Num_Distinct_Pts = value),
                                         aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                        levels = 
                                                          c(
                                                            sort(unique(colnames(solecancerpivotage %>% 
                                                                                   dplyr::select(-c(
                                                                                     OTHER,
                                                                                     Total, 
                                                                                     Age_stratum)))))
                                                            ,
                                                            "OTHER")
                                         ),
                                         y = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                                         fill = factor(Cancer,
                                                       levels = 
                                                         c(
                                                           sort(unique(colnames(solecancerpivotage %>% 
                                                                                  dplyr::select(-c(
                                                                                    OTHER,
                                                                                    Total, 
                                                                                    Age_stratum)))))
                                                           ,
                                                           "OTHER")
                                         ))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                vjust = -1),
            color = "black",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 3.5,
            alpha = 0.5) + # add num pts above each bar
  ggtitle("Cancers vs. Ages of Cancer Diagnoses in Individuals with Germline p53 Mutations") +
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Number of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Cancer") +
  facet_wrap2(. ~ Age,
              #strip.position = "right",
              #labeller = labeller(groupwrap = label_wrap_gen(10)), # wrap labels on right based on characters
              ncol = 3,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels

  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)
                     #,
                     #n.breaks = 7
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, (solecancerpivotage %>%
                                 subset(Age_stratum != "Total") %>%
                                 dplyr::select(-c(Total
                                                  #,
                                                  #OTHER
                                 )) %>%
                                 reshape2::melt() %>%
                                 pull(value) %>%
                                 na.omit() %>%
                                 max() %>%
                                 plyr::round_any(50,
                                                 ceiling)))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CC79A7",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#009E73",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#999999"
                               ,
                               "#000000"
                               #,

                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +

                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
```

``` r
# to minimize above crowding, make faceted barchart of sex vs number of pts per cancer
barchart_facet_sex_tissue_sole <- ggplot(solecancerpivotsex %>%
                                           subset(Sex != "Total") %>%
                                           mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                         Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                         TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>%
                                           mutate(Sex = paste0(Sex,
                                                               " (",
                                                               format(Total, 
                                                                      big.mark = ",", 
                                                                      trim = TRUE),
                                                               " individuals)")) %>%
                                           dplyr::select(-c(Total
                                                            #,
                                                            #OTHER
                                           )) %>% 
                                           mutate(across(everything(), 
                                                         ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
                                           reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                           dplyr::rename(Cancer = variable, 
                                                         Num_Distinct_Pts = value),
                                         aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                        levels = 
                                                          c(
                                                            sort(unique(colnames(solecancerpivotsex %>% 
                                                                                   dplyr::select(-c(
                                                                                     OTHER,
                                                                                     Total, 
                                                                                     Sex)))))
                                                            ,
                                                            "OTHER")
                                         ),
                                         y = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                                         fill = factor(Cancer,
                                                       levels = 
                                                         c(
                                                           sort(unique(colnames(solecancerpivotsex %>% 
                                                                                  dplyr::select(-c(
                                                                                    OTHER,
                                                                                    Total, 
                                                                                    Sex)))))
                                                           ,
                                                           "OTHER")
                                         ))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                vjust = -1),
            color = "black",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 3.5,
            alpha = 0.5) + # add num pts above each bar
  ggtitle("Cancers vs. Sex in Individuals with Germline p53 Mutations") +
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Number of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Cancer") +
  facet_wrap2(. ~ Sex,
              #strip.position = "right",
              #labeller = labeller(groupwrap = label_wrap_gen(10)), # wrap labels on right based on characters
              ncol = 2,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x") + # show internal axes but without x labels
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)
                     #,
                     #n.breaks = 7
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, (solecancerpivotsex %>%
                                 subset(Sex != "Total") %>%
                                 dplyr::select(-c(Total
                                                  #,
                                                  #OTHER
                                 )) %>%
                                 reshape2::melt() %>%
                                 pull(value) %>%
                                 na.omit() %>%
                                 max() %>%
                                 plyr::round_any(400,
                                                 ceiling)))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CC79A7",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#009E73",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#999999"
                               ,
                               "#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(-4, "lines"),
```

``` r
# sort by highest to lowest tissue proportion which is breast
cancerspertimeorder <- cancerspertime_melted[cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif == 'BREAST',]
cancerspertime_melted$Sequence <- factor(cancerspertime_melted$Sequence, 
                                         levels = cancerspertimeorder$Sequence[order(cancerspertimeorder$Proportion)])
cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif <- factor(cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif,
                                             levels = rev(unique(cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif)))

# make 100% stacked barchart with ggplot2 with reversed tissue order i.e. highest to lowest
cancerseqbarchart <- ggplot(cancerspertime_melted, 
                            aes(x = Sequence, 
                                y = Proportion, 
                                fill = Tissue_modif)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("# cancers/# pts") + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Tissue",
                             reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cancerspertime_melted$Sequence)), 
                   expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5, 0, 0, 0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0, 5, 0, 0), "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14))
```

``` r
# proportion of how 40+ pts cutoff captures most pts with p53 muts
solepropor_over40muts <- (solecancerpivottype %>%
                            subset(Short_topo %in% origdbcancersover100$Short_topo) %>%
                            pull(Total) %>%
                            sum()) / n_distinct(origdbsolecancer$Individual_code)

zed <- origdbsolecancer %>%
  group_by(Short_topo) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>%
  arrange(-n)

vec <- c(solepropor_over40muts,
         1 - solepropor_over40muts)

raw <- c(solecancerpivottype %>%
           subset(Short_topo %in% origdbcancersover100$Short_topo) %>%
           pull(Total) %>%
           sum(),
         solecancerpivottype %>%
           subset(Short_topo == "OTHER") %>%
           pull(Total))

barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(zed$n),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Number of distinct individuals", 
        xlab = "Cancer",
        main = "Prevalence of Distinct Individuals with p53-Mutant Cancers",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(as.numeric(zed$n)),
                                    10, 
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(zed$Short_topo %in% origdbcancersover100$Short_topo,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA) 
abline(h = 40,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
```

``` r
# make df of prevalence of cancers in entire sole dataset
df_prev <- zed %>%
  adorn_totals() %>%
  mutate(prop = n/last(n)) %>% 
  subset(Short_topo != "Total") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cancer = Short_topo) %>% 
  mutate(Cancer_Label = paste0(Cancer,
                               " (",
                               format(n, 
                                      big.mark = ",", 
                                      trim = TRUE),
                               " individuals)")) %>% 
  mutate(Cancer_Label = ifelse(n == 1,
                               gsub("individuals",
                                    "individual",
                                    Cancer_Label),
                               Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  mutate(coloring = ifelse(Cancer %in% core_LFS_tumors,
                           "subset",
                           "cancer"))

# make barchart
justify_sole_cancer_prevalence_barchart <- ggplot(df_prev,
                                                  aes(x = factor(Cancer_Label,
                                                                 levels = unique(df_prev$Cancer_Label)),
                                                      y = prop,
                                                      fill = relevel(as.factor(coloring),
                                                                     ref = "subset"))) + 
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge2(), 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Cancers in Individuals with Germline Mutations in TP53") + 
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
                     limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(df_prev$prop),
                                                   0.1,
                                                   f = ceiling) * 1.0000001)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "skyblue")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
```

# **Drawing Clustered Heatmaps** {#heatmaps}

$~$

Next, I drew clustered heatmaps for mutation types and positions vs. cancers or no cancer, ages, or sexes. In all cases I have at least clustered cancers and ages, while I have also clustered mutation categories when depicted. I have not clustered mutated positions to preserve numeric order and p53 domains, and they would cluster at hotspots first anyways followed by more dispersed arrangements.

``` r
# see if age, sex, cancer, or other variables could explain different mutational profiles seen in heatmaps
# to do this, need multivariate analysis incorporating these variables into GLM to see what is independently associated with mutations

# first need hierarchical clustering of mutations scaled data in heatmap to identify clusters
ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust <- stats::hclust(dist(scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)), # for muts as rows
                                                    method = "euclidean"),
                                               method = "complete")
plot(as.dendrogram(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust),
     ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust$height), 1, f = ceiling)))
height_to_cut <- 3.5
abline(h = height_to_cut,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
```

<img src="figures/multivariateGLM-1.svg" width="100%" height="100%" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

``` r
ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters <- stats::cutree(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust, 
                                                 h = height_to_cut) # height to cut at for the clusters you visually think are best, if want to define number of clusters do k = # but bear in mind this is based on the clusters achieved from uniform height, not what you think the end result clusters are at the bottom

# color code clusters and add cluster group numbers to dendrogram
clust_cutree <- dendextend:::cutree(as.dendrogram(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust), 
                                    k = max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters), 
                                    order_clusters_as_data = FALSE)
idx <- order(names(clust_cutree))
clust_cutree <- clust_cutree[idx]
df_merge <- merge(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters,
                  clust_cutree,
                  by = 'row.names')
df_merge_sorted <- df_merge[order(df_merge$y),]
lbls <- unique(df_merge_sorted$x)
plot(dendextend::color_branches(as.dendrogram(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust) %>% 
                                  dendextend::set("labels_cex", 
                                                  1.1) %>%
                                  dendextend::set("labels_col",
                                                  k = length(lbls)) %>%
                                  dendextend::set("branches_lwd",
                                                  2), 
                                k = max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters),
```

``` r
ncol(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered) == n_distinct(origdb_allACC_sole_pts$ProtDescription)

# add cluster numbers to orig df
origdb_allACC_sole_pts_forGLM <- left_join(origdb_allACC_sole_pts,
                                           scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)) %>% 
                                             as.data.frame() %>%
                                             rownames_to_column("ProtDescription") %>%
                                             dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription)) %>%
                                             add_column(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters) %>%
                                             dplyr::rename(Age_vs_mut_cluster = ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters),
                                           by = "ProtDescription")

origdb_allACC_sole_pts_forGLM <- left_join(origdb_allACC_sole_pts_forGLM,
```

``` r
#                        clustermethod = hclustCBI,

# 
# barplot(bootres$bootmean, 
#         ylim = c(0, 1),
#         names.arg = c(1:max(solecancerpos_clusters)),
#         main = "Cluster stability",
#         xlab = "Cluster", 
#         ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
#         col = ifelse(bootres$bootmean < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
#                      "red",
#                      "gray"),
#         font.lab = 2,
#         las = 1)
# # abline(h = 0.6,
# #        col = "red",
# #        lty = 2,
# #        lwd = 2)
# abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster
#        col = "forestgreen",
#        lty = 2,
#        lwd = 2)

# calc jaccard similarity for all 1:ideal clusters' stabilities
bootres_all <- lapply(1:5 # 5 close enough to ideal
                      #as.numeric(silhouette_solecancerpos$data$clusters[which.max(silhouette_solecancerpos$data$y)])
                      ,
                      FUN = function(x) clusterboot(scale(t(solecancerpos_matrix_ordered)), 
                                                    clustermethod = hclustCBI,
                                                    scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
                                                    method = "complete", 
                                                    k = x, 
                                                    seed = 1212,
                                                    count = FALSE))

# plot all cluster numbers' jaccard barplots with lines indicating stable clusters
lapply(1:length(bootres_all),
       FUN = function(x) {barplot(bootres_all[[x]][["bootmean"]], 
                                  xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
                                  ylim = c(0, 1),
                                  names.arg = c(1:x),
                                  main = "Cluster stability",
                                  xlab = "Cluster", 
                                  ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
                                  col = ifelse(bootres_all[[x]][["bootmean"]] < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
                                               "red",
                                               "gray"),
                                  font.lab = 2,
                                  las = 1)
         abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster
                col = "forestgreen",
                lty = 2,
```

``` r
# calc k-means clustering as alternative to hierarchical clustering
# calc kmeans clustering for 1:ideal hclust number of clusters from silhouette plot
set.seed(1212)
solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all <- lapply(X = 1:5 # 5 close enough to ideal
                                        #as.numeric(silhouette_solecancerpos$data$clusters[which.max(silhouette_solecancerpos$data$y)])
                                        , # ideal cluster number with max avg silhouette width (where the dashed line is on plot)
                                        FUN = function(x) {set.seed(1212)
                                          stats::kmeans(scale(t(solecancerpos_matrix_ordered)),
                                                        centers = x, # num of clusters, 1:ideal
                                                        nstart = 50)})

# compare whether things clustered together even if cluster labels are different, hierarchical cluster is rows and kmeans is columns, so order kmeans columns by max hierarchical cluster so that diagonal is the maximal matching, since cluster labels won't be the same but which muts go into which clusters should be similar and maximized in diagonal
# do across all kmeans and hclust calculated; first make matrix of hclust vs kmeans, get way to reorder cols to make diagonal maximum, reorder matrices per these cols, add rowsums total at ends of matrices, convert each matrix to df, rename 1x1 df because of how R named it
consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all),
         FUN = function(x) table(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                 solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]]))

col_reordering <-
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) replace(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                           "first"), 
                                   duplicated(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                                      "first")), 
                                   setdiff(1:ncol(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]]), 
                                           max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                                   "first"))))

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) (consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]])[,col_reordering[[x]]])

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(rapply(list(cbind(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[1]],
                           Total = consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[1]]),
                     lapply(2:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep), 
                            FUN = function(x) cbind(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]],
                                                    Total = rowSums(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]])))), 
                enquote, 
                how = "unlist"), 
         eval)

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) as.data.frame(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]]))

names(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[1]]) <- gsub("V",
                                                              "",
                                                              names(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[1]])) 

# divide across for fraction of hierarchical that matched in kmeans, should be 1 if perfect match
# do for all dfs made
consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_calc <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all),
         FUN = function(x) consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[x]] %>% 
           mutate_at(vars(1:Total),
                     .funs = ~./Total) %>% 
           dplyr::select(-Total))

# calculate rand indices and adjusted rand indices across all dfs for clustering similarity for barplots
solecancerpos_all_rand_index <- unlist(lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all),
                                              FUN = function(x) fossil::rand.index(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                                                                   solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]])))

solecancerpos_all_adj_rand_index <- unlist(lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all),
                                                  FUN = function(x) fossil::adj.rand.index(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                                                                           solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]])))

# plot kmeans clusters overlap for all possible clusters
lapply(1:length(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all),
       FUN = function(x) fviz_cluster(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]],
                                      data = scale(t(solecancerpos_matrix_ordered)),

                                        size = 12),
```

``` r
# plot jaccard similarity to assess cluster stability
set.seed(1212)
bootres <- clusterboot(scale(t(solecancerpos_matrix_ordered)), 
                       clustermethod = kmeansCBI,
                       scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
                       krange = max(solecancerpos_clusters), 
                       runs = 50,
                       iter.max = 10,
                       scaledata = FALSE,
                       seed = 1212,
                       count = FALSE)

barplot(bootres$bootmean, 
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        names.arg = c(1:max(solecancerpos_clusters)),
        main = "Cluster stability",
        xlab = "Cluster", 
        ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
        col = ifelse(bootres$bootmean < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
                     "red",
                     "gray"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1)
# abline(h = 0.6,
#        col = "red",
#        lty = 2,
#        lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster
       col = "forestgreen",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_cancer_pos_lm, 
                    trace = FALSE, 
                    test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Df,
                   AIC,
                   LRT)) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              # Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic == "TransactivationClass" ~ "Transactivation",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`p-val` = `Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

# **Identifying Mutations Affecting Splicing** {#splicing}

$~$

$~$


``` r
# indicate whether patients have splicing and isoform positions affected
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

origdbdefcancer_forsplice <- origdbdefcancer %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

breakdown_forsplice <- breakdown %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

# rename values in exon and intron column to follow typical intron # syntax instead of #-intron
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbdefcancer_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbdefcancer_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                    "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                    "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

# "i" or "e" in front means mut w/i indicated intron or exon but no info on precise location, so  need to add e#exon and i#intron to each exon or intron counts too, particularly for sole pts
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^e([0-9]+)exon", 
                                                                 "exon \\1")

origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^i([0-9]+)intron", 
                                                                 "intron \\1") # no i#introns in dataset but just for completeness

# make pivot tables for specific splice and other positions proportions across pts
solespliceperpos <- PivotTable$new()
solespliceperpos$addData(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice)
solespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform") 
solespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
solespliceperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                   summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
solespliceperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,
                                   orderBy = "calculation",
                                   sortOrder = "desc")
solespliceperpos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

multspliceperpos <- PivotTable$new()
multspliceperpos$addData(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice)
multspliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform") 
multspliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
multspliceperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                   summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
multspliceperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,
                                   orderBy = "calculation",
                                   sortOrder = "desc")
multspliceperpos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

nonespliceperpos <- PivotTable$new()
nonespliceperpos$addData(breakdown_forsplice %>% subset(Unaffected == "true"))
nonespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform") 
nonespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
nonespliceperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",

solesplicepercancerpos <- PivotTable$new()

solesplicepercancer_pivot_calc <- solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
  rename_at(vars(2:(ncol(.) - 1)),
            ~ paste0(.,
                     " (",
                     solesplicepercancer_pivot[nrow(solesplicepercancer_pivot), .],
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),

  dplyr::select(-Total)

                   Total,
                   OTHER)) %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames("ProtDescription") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%

  mutate(Cancer = paste0(Cancer,
```
