``` r
                                     "_Not"))] <- NA 

contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice[c(paste0(colnames(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice)[-1],
                                             "_Not"))] <- NA 

# reorder cols such that pt/cancer is first and not muts immediately follow respective muts
contingency_germ_som_splice <- contingency_germ_som_splice[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_splice))] %>% 
  relocate(Patient)

contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice <- 
  contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice))] %>% 
  relocate(Cancer)

# subtract final pt/cancer tally from each mut in its own vector, add to df and collapse rows to remove NAs, thus line up NAs where new subtracted values only go into other mut cols
contingency_germ_som_splice <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_splice,
                                     c(NA, (last(solespliceperpos_pivot$Total) - contingency_germ_som_splice[1,] %>% as.numeric()) %>% head(-1))) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   ~ na.omit(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(Total = last(solespliceperpos_pivot$Total))

# because need to subtract total minus each previous column, make intermediate df with all total pt numbers per cancer and subtract total from previous column to col of interest
blah <- left_join(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice,
                  solesplicepercancerpos_pivot %>% # get total number of pts with each cancer
                    dplyr::select(-c(Isoform,
                                     Total,
                                     OTHER)) %>% 
                    last() %>% 
                    mutate(ProtDescription = "Total") %>%
                    remove_rownames() %>% 
                    column_to_rownames("ProtDescription") %>% 
                    t() %>% 
                    as.data.frame() %>% 
                    rownames_to_column("Cancer") %>% 
                    mutate(Cancer = paste0(Cancer,
                                           "_germline sole")),
                  by = "Cancer")

# define columns to be subtracted
columns_to_subtract <- colnames(blah)[grepl("_Not",
                                            colnames(blah))]

# subtract cols
blah[, columns_to_subtract] <- lapply(columns_to_subtract, 
                                      function(col) {
                                        index <- match(col, 
                                                       names(blah)) # index of current col
                                        blah[, "Total"] - blah[, index - 1] # total - prev col
                                      })

contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice <- blah
```

``` r
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::prop.test(., 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
```

``` r
# pairwise prop test to confirm if percent of splice muts overall in cancers and total differ, so need to make matrix of 2 cols, first is success and second is failures i.e. yes and no, and then send to function, don't need multiple hypothesis correction with p adjustment because these are independent tests made
(solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")
```

``` r
top_splice_sole_gridprep <- condformat(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                      filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                        "One") & Isoform == "yes") %>% 
                                      left_join(., 
                                                solespliceperpos_pivot %>% 
                                                  dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                                  Total)), 
                                                by = "ProtDescription") %>% 
                                      arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                      head(10) %>%
                                      mutate(Proportion = plyr::round_any(Calc * 100,
                                                                          0.01)) %>%
                                      dplyr::select(c(Label,
                                                      Proportion,
                                                      Total)) %>%
                                      dplyr::rename(Mutation = Label,
                                                    Percent = Proportion,
                                                    Patients = Total)) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_splice_sole_grid <- grid.arrange(top_splice_sole_gridprep,
                                  top = textGrob("Prevalence of Top Splice Mutations Across \nIndividuals with One Germline p53-Mutant Cancer",
                                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
                                                                          0.01)) %>%
                                        mutate(ExonIntron = str_to_title(ExonIntron)) %>% 
                                      dplyr::select(c(ExonIntron,
                                                      Proportion,
                                                      Total)) %>%
                                      dplyr::rename(Intron = ExonIntron,
                                                    Percent = Proportion,
                                                    Patients = Total)) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_intron_sole_grid <- grid.arrange(top_intron_sole_gridprep,
                                  top = textGrob("Prevalence of Top Introns Mutated Across \nIndividuals with One Germline p53-Mutant Cancer",
                                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
# compare intronic overall between germline and somatic

                   alternative = "two.sided",
```

```
0.06532067 0.06839678
```

``` r
top_consensus_sd_sa_sole_gridprep <- condformat(solespliceconsensus_overall_pivot_calc %>% 
                                                  mutate(Label = paste0(str_to_title(ExonIntron), 
                                                                        ", ",
                                                                        Splice_site)) %>% 
                                                  filter(str_detect(Splice_site, 
                                                                    "consensus")) %>% 
                                                  left_join(.,
                                                            solespliceconsensus_overall_pivot %>% 
                                                              mutate(Label = paste0(str_to_title(ExonIntron), 
                                                                                    ", ",
                                                                                    Splice_site)) %>% 
                                                              dplyr::select(c(Label, 
                                                                              `Count of distinct individuals`)) %>%
                                                              dplyr::rename(Total = `Count of distinct individuals`),
                                                            by = "Label") %>% 
                                                  arrange(-`Count of distinct individuals`) %>%
                                                  head(10) %>%
                                                  mutate(Proportion = plyr::round_any(`Count of distinct individuals` * 100,
                                                                                      0.01)) %>%
                                                  dplyr::select(c(Label,
                                                                  Proportion,
                                                                  Total)) %>%
                                                  dplyr::rename(Location = Label,
                                                                Percent = Proportion,
                                                                Patients = Total)) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_consensus_sd_sa_sole_grid <- grid.arrange(top_consensus_sd_sa_sole_gridprep,
                                              top = textGrob("Prevalence of Top Consensus SD/SA Mutated Across \nIndividuals with One Germline p53-Mutant Cancer",
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_age_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(cancer_freq_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
barchart_pts_splice_none <- ggplot(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot %>% 
                                  subset(Isoform == "yes"),
                                aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                               levels = sort(unique(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                             decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]), # none, sole, mult
                                    y = Calc, 
                                    fill = factor(Patient,
                                                  levels = sort(unique(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +   
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Calc * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = c(solesplice_pivot %>% subset(Isoform == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          multsplice_pivot %>% subset(Isoform == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          nonesplice_pivot %>% subset(Isoform == "yes") %>% pull(Total)
                          ) # original order in dataframe
                ),
            color = "white",
            size = 4,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            y = 0.005,
            hjust = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline Mutations \nin TP53 Affecting Splicing in Individuals") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Patient type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                     limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                     subset(Isoform == "yes") %>%
                                                     pull(Calc) %>%
                                                     max(),
                                                   0.12,
                                                   ceiling) * 1.0000001)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgray",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
barchart_pts_splice_none
```

``` r
barchart_facet_pts_keysplicepos_none <- ggplot(pt_none_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%

                                                                decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",

  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Calc * 100,

                               "%")),
            color = "black",

  labs(fill = "Patient type") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline Mutations in TP53 Affecting Splicing in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  facet_wrap2(. ~ factor(Label,
                         levels = c("T125T", 
                                    "M133T", 
                                    "M133R")),
              drop = FALSE, # ensure muts not in dataset still shown as blanks
              axes = "y") + # show all inner y axes labels too
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), 
                     limits = c(0, ((pt_none_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>% 
                                       subset(Isoform == "yes" & Label %in% c("T125T", 
                                                                              "M133T", 
                                                                              "M133R")) %>% 
                                       pull(Calc) %>% 
                                       max() %>% 
                                       plyr::round_any(0.02,
                                                       f = ceiling)) * 1.00001))) + 
  scale_x_discrete(
    #limits = rev, 
    expand = c(0,0),
    drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset are still shown as blanks
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgray",

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,

        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",

                                  face = "bold",

        panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "lines"),
```

``` r
# add total to df
```

``` r
plot_df_germ_som_overall_splice <- rbind(germ_overall_splice,
                                      som_overall_splice)

# barchart of germ vs som overall splice props
barchart_germ_som_overall_splice <- ggplot(plot_df_germ_som_overall_splice,
                                        aes(x = Type,
                                            y = Proportion,
                                            fill = Type)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Proportion * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  xlab("Dataset") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Dataset") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Splice Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), 
                     limits = c(0, ((plot_df_germ_som_overall_splice %>% 
                                       pull(Proportion) %>% 
                                       max() %>% 
                                       plyr::round_any(0.05, 
                                                       f = ceiling)) * 1.000001))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    #limits = rev, 
    expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
  ) + # show all inner y axes labels too
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), 
                     limits = c(0, ((germ_som_cancers_same_splice_ggplot %>%

  scale_x_discrete(

    expand = c(0,0)) +

                               # "#CC79A7",
                               #                            "#E69F00",
                               #                            "#009E73",
                               #                            "#56B4E9",
                               #                            "#999999",
                               #"#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"

  theme_classic() +
```

``` r
# boxplot of whether splicing affects ages of dx
sole_splice_age_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   Isoform,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has splice 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              Isoform,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code))))
  splicechisq_df %>% 
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                       "OTHER")),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(Isoform), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") +
```

``` r
top_splice_sole_damaging_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
                                               subset(ProtDescription %in% c("M133T",
                                                                             "M133R",
                                                                             "T125T")) %>%
                                               dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                               TransactivationClass,
                                                               SIFTClass,
                                                               DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                               BayesDel,
                                                               REVEL, 
                                                               Polyphen2,
                                                               AGVGDClass, 
                                                               DNEclass)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                                               dplyr::rename(Mutation = ProtDescription, 
                                                             `Transactivation Class` = TransactivationClass,
                                                             `SIFT Class` = SIFTClass, 
                                                             `DNE_LOF Class` = DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                             PolyPhen2 = Polyphen2,
                                                             `Align-GVGD Class` = AGVGDClass, 
                                                             DNE = DNEclass) %>%
                                               arrange(abs(parse_number(Mutation))) %>%
                                               replace(is.na(.),
                                                       "") %>% 
                                               distinct()) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_splice_sole_damaging_grid <- grid.arrange(top_splice_sole_damaging_gridprep,
                                  top = textGrob("Selected p53 Mutants Tests or Predictions of Damaging Function",
                                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(splicechisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(splicechisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
```

``` r
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(splicechisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(splicechisq_df_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       splicechisq_df_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic"))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>%

  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(splicedf_matchsomatic_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                         Cancer_Label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = Cancer_Label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Adrenal cortical",
                                              "Adrenocortical",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       splicedf_matchgermline_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                         match_label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = match_label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("\\,.*",
                                              "",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Soft tissue sarcoma",
                                              "Soft tissues",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic")) %>% 
  mutate(BayesDel = as.numeric(BayesDel)) %>% 
  mutate(REVEL = as.numeric(REVEL))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Cancer,
                  Dataset,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(df_for_gt$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>%

               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>%

               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Age_at_diagnosis,
                                    Sex,
                                    Cancer_Label)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis",
                              Cancer_Label ~ "Cancer")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Cancer_Label)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Cancer_Label ~ "Cancer"),
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(breakdown_forsplice %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                   cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                   Isoform)) %>%
                   distinct() %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)),
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(cancer_freq_pt_type ~ "Cancer frequency"),
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                   Cancer_Label,
                   Sex)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   # mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                   #                               Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                   #                               TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Age_at_diagnosis)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>%
                   # mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
```
``` r
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Sex)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- breakdown_forsplice %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  subset(cancer_freq_pt_type %in% c("multiple", 
                                    "none")) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  Isoform)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- breakdown_forsplice %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  Isoform)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

```
95 percent confidence interval:

odds ratio
```

``` r
contingency_germ_som_splice_gridprep <- condformat(contingency_germ_som_splice) %>%
  rule_text_bold(Total,
                 expression = Total > 0) %>%
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

contingency_germ_som_splice_grid <- grid.arrange(contingency_germ_som_splice_gridprep,
                                                 top = textGrob("Contingency Table of Individuals with Selected Germline vs Somatic Mutations in TP53 and Cancer",
                                                                hjust = 0.5,
                                                                gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
                                                             relocate(Dataset,
                                                                      .before = Cancer)) %>%
  rule_text_bold(Total,
                 expression = Total > 0) %>%
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
```

``` r
  remove_rownames()

        file = paste0(table_path, "top_ATO_in_germline_vector.rds"))

        file = paste0(table_path, "top_muts_germline_vector.rds"))

# read in analogous vectors from somatic cbioportal dataset
top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector <- readRDS(file = paste0(analogous_somatic_path, "top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector.rds"))

top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector <- readRDS(file = paste0(analogous_somatic_path, "top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector.rds"))

# combine somatic cbioportal with germline muts so that all top muts in both are plotted at once
top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined <- unique(c(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                           top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined <- unique(c(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                            top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

# color code muts exclusively in germ or som, and keep common muts as black 
# setdiff syntax matters, here saying check which elements of first vector i.e germline muts not in second vector i.e the overlap of germline and somatic, would need to reverse terms for other way or do union(setdiff(1,2), setdiff(2,1)) to get what is not common in in either vector
# setdiff(x, y) returns the elements of x that are not in y but asymmetric difference, so setdiff(y, x) gives what elements of y are not in x and could be different answer

# which germline muts not in germ and som overlap i.e. exclusive to germline
top_ATO_combined_germ_exclusive <- setdiff(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                           intersect(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                     top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

top_muts_combined_germ_exclusive <- setdiff(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                            intersect(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                                      top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

# which somatic muts not in germ and som overlap i.e. exclusive to somatic
top_ATO_combined_som_cbio_exclusive <- setdiff(top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector,
                                               intersect(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                         top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

top_muts_combined_som_cbio_exclusive <- setdiff(top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector,
                                                intersect(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                                          top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

# set color of strip i.e. facet text and create named vectors of colors for plots
strip_text_color_topATO <- dplyr::case_when(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined %in%  top_ATO_combined_germ_exclusive ~ "#56B4E9",
                                            top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% top_ATO_combined_som_cbio_exclusive ~ "#CC79A7",
                                            top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% intersect(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                                                          top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector) ~ "black",
                                            TRUE ~ "notyet")

strip_text_color_topmuts <- dplyr::case_when(top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% top_muts_combined_germ_exclusive ~ "#56B4E9",
                                             top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% top_muts_combined_som_cbio_exclusive ~ "#CC79A7",
                                             top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% intersect(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                                                                            top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector) ~ "black",
                                             TRUE ~ "notyet")

strip_text_color_topATO_scale <- setNames(strip_text_color_topATO,
                                          top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined)

strip_text_color_topmuts_scale <- setNames(strip_text_color_topmuts,
                                           top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined)

# create conditional strips objects that can be added to facet plots and order by codon number
conditional_strips_ATO <- strip_themed(text_x = elem_list_text(colour = strip_text_color_topATO_scale[order(abs(parse_number(names(strip_text_color_topATO_scale))))], 
                                                               face = 'bold'))

conditional_strips_muts <- strip_themed(text_x = elem_list_text(colour = strip_text_color_topmuts_scale[order(abs(parse_number(names(strip_text_color_topmuts_scale))))],
                                                                face = 'bold'))

# confirm that facet colors ordering is the same as facet levels
table(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined[order(abs(parse_number(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined)))] == names(strip_text_color_topATO_scale[order(abs(parse_number(names(strip_text_color_topATO_scale))))])) # should be all 10 (now 9) TRUE
```

``` r
# b/c 1 mut not in germline but in somatic, need to make placeholder filled with 0

# reorder colnames per top ATO vector which will be how somatic is made, helping rbind later on

           .after = 1)

contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO <- contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO %>% 
  relocate(all_of(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined),

# reorder cols such that pt/cancer is first and not muts immediately follow respective muts
```

``` r
  arrange(Patient) %>%

# then remove ATO equaling Total, transpose with yes first then no, prop.test
(contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO %>% 
    subset(ATO != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("ATO") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::prop.test(., 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
```

``` r
                                                             count(Family_code) %>% 
                                                             arrange(-n) %>% 
                                                             tail(1) %>% # get least frequent family count
                                                             pull(Family_code) %>% 
                                                             as.vector())
breakdown_forATO$SIFTClass <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$SIFTClass,
                                                         ref = "Tolerated")
breakdown_forATO$DNE_LOFclass <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$DNE_LOFclass,
                                                            ref = "unclass.")
breakdown_forATO$Domain <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$Domain,
                                                      ref = "NA")
breakdown_forATO$ExonIntron <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$ExonIntron,
                                                          ref = "5'UTR")
breakdown_forATO$CpG_site <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$CpG_site,
                                                        ref = "no")
breakdown_forATO$Splice_site <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$Splice_site,
                                                           ref = "no")
breakdown_forATO$Residue_function <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$Residue_function,
                                                                ref = "Exposed")
breakdown_forATO$Rescuable <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$Rescuable,
                                                       ref = "Not documented")
breakdown_forATO$ATO <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$ATO,
                                                       ref = "no")
breakdown_forATO$cancer_freq_pt_type <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                                       ref = "none")
breakdown_forATO$Dead <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$Dead,
                          ref = "false")

# multinomial regressions
solecancer_age_ATO_lm <- nnet::multinom(formula = Age_stratum ~ ATO + 
                                          #Sex + 
                                          #Cancer_Label + 
                                          #Population + Region + 
                                          SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + Effect + Domain + Residue_function,
                                           data = origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
                                             drop_na(Age_stratum,
                                                     #Sex,
                                                     ATO,
                                                     #Cancer_Label,
                                                     #Population,
                                                     #Region,
                                                     SIFTClass,
                                                     DNE_LOFclass,
                                                     Effect,
                                                     Domain,
                                                     Residue_function)
)
```

``` r
# best models are binomial for follow up testing, so define clinical question with binary outcome, make logistic regressions where outcome is binomial, ensure variables used are not collinear with adjusted GVIF < sqrt(5) i.e. 2.23, then rerun regression on training fraction of data and predict on test fraction of data

# first, want to see if demographics predict ATO rescuable mutation status which is binary

# make binomial logistic regression
solecancer_ATO_binom_lm <- stats::glm(formula = ATO ~ Sex + Age_stratum + Cancer_Label + 
                                        #Population + 
                                        Region #+ 
                                      #SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + 
                                      #Effect 
                                      #+ Domain + Residue_function
                                      ,
                                      family = "binomial",
                                      data = origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
                                        drop_na(ATO,
                                                Sex,
                                                Age_stratum,
                                                Cancer_Label,
                                                #Population,
                                                Region,
                                                #SIFTClass,
                                                #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                #Effect
                                                #,
                                                #Domain,
                                                #Residue_function
                                        )
)
summary(solecancer_ATO_binom_lm)
```

``` r
# remove variables with adjusted GVIF > 2.23 i.e. sqrt(5) and likely collinear, and rerun modified model
# modifying model not needed, so create 80% test & 20% train fractions of data for predictive strength of model
set.seed(1212)
# Splitting the data into train and test
index <- caret::createDataPartition(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO$ATO, # vector of outcomes
                                    times = 1, # number of partitions to make
                                    p = 0.8, # fraction for training
                                    list = FALSE)
train_data <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO[index, ]
test_data <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO[-index, ]

# Training the model
solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm <- stats::glm(formula = ATO ~ Sex + Age_stratum + Cancer_Label + 
                                        #Population + 
                                        Region #+ 
                                      #SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + 
                                      #Effect 
                                      #+ Domain + Residue_function
                                      ,
                                      family = "binomial",
                                      data = train_data %>% 
                                        drop_na(ATO,
                                                Sex,
                                                Age_stratum,
                                                Cancer_Label,
                                                #Population,
                                                Region,
                                                #SIFTClass,
                                                #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                #Effect
                                                #,
                                                #Domain,
                                                #Residue_function
                                        )
)
summary(solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm)
```

``` r
# Predicting in the test dataset
pred_prob_solecancer_ATO_binom <- predict(solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm,
                                          newdata = test_data %>% 
                                            drop_na(ATO,
                                                    Sex,
                                                    Age_stratum,
                                                    Cancer_Label,

                                                    #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                    #Effect
                                                    #,
                                                    #Domain,
                                                    #Residue_function
                                            ),
                                          type = "response")

pred_classes_solecancer_ATO_binom <- ifelse(pred_prob_solecancer_ATO_binom >= 0.5,
                                            "yes", 
                                            "no")

# Create the confusion matrix
# not predicting properly so not pursued further

#                                                         test_data$ATO),
#                                                   positive = "yes")
# print(cm_solecancer_ATO_binom)












# second, see if early age of diagnosis (binary) predicted by ATO status independent of other mut variables







# pairwise prop test to confirm if percent of ATO muts overall in cancers and total differ, so need to make matrix of 2 cols, first is success and second is failures i.e. yes and no, and then send to function, don't need multiple hypothesis correction with p adjustment because these are independent tests made
(soleATOpercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(ATO != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("ATO") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")
```
