``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_age_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

$~$


``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(cancer_freq_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

$~$


``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_survival_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
barchart_pts_ATO_none <- ggplot(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot %>% 
                                  subset(ATO == "yes"),
                                aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                               levels = sort(unique(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                             decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]), # none, sole, mult
                                    y = Calc, 
                                    fill = factor(Patient,
                                                  levels = sort(unique(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +   
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Calc * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = c(soleATO_pivot %>% subset(ATO == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          multATO_pivot %>% subset(ATO == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          noneATO_pivot %>% subset(ATO == "yes") %>% pull(Total)
                          ) # original order in dataframe
                ),
            color = "white",
            size = 4,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            y = 0.01,
            hjust = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Patient type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                     limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                     subset(ATO == "yes") %>%
                                                     pull(Calc) %>%
                                                     max(),
                                                   0.20,
                                                   ceiling) * 1.0000001)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgray",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
barchart_pts_ATO_none
```

``` r
# because multiple germline muts in pts, just in case percents != 100%, shrink other muts to fit expected %
to_fit_mult <- 1 - (sum(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                          subset(ATO == "yes" & grepl("Multiple", 
                                                      Patient)) %>%
                          pull(Calc)))

to_fit_all <- 1 - (sum(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                         subset(ATO == "yes" & grepl("All", 
                                                     Patient)) %>%
                         pull(Calc)))

to_fit_sole <- 1 - (sum(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                          subset(ATO == "yes" & grepl("One", 
                                                      Patient)) %>%
                          pull(Calc)))

# plot zoomed in stacked barchart with adjusted %
stackedbarchart_pts_ATOperpos <- ggplot(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                          mutate(Calc_label = Calc) %>%
                                          mutate(Calc_label = dplyr::case_when(ATO == "no" & grepl("Multiple", 
                                                                                                   Patient) ~ to_fit_mult/nrow(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                 subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("Multiple", 
                                                                                                                                                            Patient))),
                                                                               ATO == "no" & grepl("All", 
                                                                                                   Patient) ~ to_fit_all/nrow(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("All", 
                                                                                                                                                           Patient))),
                                                                               ATO == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                   Patient) ~ to_fit_sole/nrow(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                 subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                                                                            Patient))),
                                                                               TRUE ~ Calc_label)), 
                                        aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                                       levels = sort(unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                     decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,3,1))]), 
                                            y = Calc_label, 
                                            fill = factor(Label,
                                                          levels = c((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                        arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                        pull(Label) %>%
                                                                        unique())[(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                                                                     unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                                     "Other")))) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Mutation") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c((plyr::round_any(min(pt_ATO_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                  subset(ATO == "no") %>%
                                                  pull(Calc)), 
                                            0.02, 
                                            f = floor)), 1.0000001), # set axis limits in coord_cartesian to zoom in on percentages
                  expand = FALSE) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hue_pal()(length(c((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                                     unique())[(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                                  arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                  pull(Label) %>%
                                                                  unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                  "Other"))) %>% 
                                 head(-1),
                               "lightgray")) + # extract automatic gradient colors and replace final one i.e. other with lightgray
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
```

``` r
plot_df_germ_som_overall_ATO <- contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
    rename_at(vars(2:ncol(.)),
              ~ paste0(str_to_lower(.),
                       " (",
                       contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO[nrow(contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO), .],
                       " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                  ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
    subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
    #dplyr::select(-Total) %>% 
    reshape2::melt() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(Type = variable,
                  Proportion = value) %>% 
  subset(ATO == "no")
```

``` r
top_ATO_sole_damaging_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
                                               subset(ProtDescription %in% c(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                                             "R158L")) %>%
                                               dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                               TransactivationClass,
                                                               SIFTClass,
                                                               DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                               BayesDel,
                                                               REVEL, 
                                                               Polyphen2,
                                                               AGVGDClass, 
                                                               DNEclass)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                                               dplyr::rename(Mutation = ProtDescription, 
                                                             `Transactivation Class` = TransactivationClass,
                                                             `SIFT Class` = SIFTClass, 
                                                             `DNE_LOF Class` = DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                             PolyPhen2 = Polyphen2,
                                                             `Align-GVGD Class` = AGVGDClass, 
                                                             DNE = DNEclass) %>%
                                               arrange(abs(parse_number(Mutation))) %>%
                                               replace(is.na(.),
                                                       "") %>% 
                                               distinct()) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)
```

``` r
stackedbarchart_pts_ATO_cancers_pos_horiz <- ggplot(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>% 
                                                      mutate(Proportion_label = Proportion) %>% 
                                                      mutate(Proportion_label = dplyr::case_when(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[1]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[1]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                      subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[1]))),
                                                                                                 ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[2]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[2]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                      subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[2]))),
                                                                                                 ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[3]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[3]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                      subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[3]))),
                                                                                                 ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[4]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[4]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                      subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[4]))),
                                                                                                 ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[5]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[5]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                      subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[5]))),
                                                                                                 ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[6]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[6]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                      subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[6]))),
                                                                                                 TRUE ~ Proportion_label)), 
                                                    aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                                   levels = soleATOpercancer_pivot_melted %>% 
                                                                     subset(ATO == "yes") %>%
                                                                     arrange(-Proportion) %>% 
                                                                     pull(Cancer) %>% 
                                                                     unique() %>% 
                                                                     as.vector()), 
                                                        y = Proportion_label, 
                                                        fill = factor(Label,
                                                                      levels = c((soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                    arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                                                    pull(Label) %>%
                                                                                    unique())[(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>% 
                                                                                                 arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                                                                 pull(Label) %>%
                                                                                                 unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                                                 "Other")))) + 
  geom_bar(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE), 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Mutation") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 7),
                     position = "right") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0),
                   limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hue_pal()(length(c((soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                     arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                                     unique())[(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>% 
                                                                  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                                  pull(Label) %>%
                                                                  unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                  "Other"))) %>% 
                                 head(-1),
                               "lightgray")) + # extract automatic gradient colors and replace final one i.e. other with lightgray
  theme_classic() + 
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, ((soleATOpercancer_pivot_melted %>% 
                             subset(ATO == "yes") %>% 
                             pull(Proportion) %>% 
                             max() %>% 
                             plyr::round_any(0.05, 
                                             f = ceiling)) * 1.00001))) + # calls coord_cartesian to set axis limits to zoom in on percentages
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x.top = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,0,10,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
# boxplot of whether Rescuable by ATO mutations affects ages of dx
sole_ATO_age_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   ATO,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has ATO 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              ATO,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code))))
  ATOchisq_df %>% 
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                       "OTHER")),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(ATO), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Rescuable by ATO Mutation") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnosis in Individuals \nwith Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(ATOchisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   BayesDel)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   REVEL)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(ATOchisq_df_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       ATOchisq_df_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic"))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   SIFTClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(df_for_gt$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9), 
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
gt::gtsave(t, 
           file = paste0(fig_path, 
                         "sole-all-germ-vs-som-ATO-vs-REVEL.png"))
```

$~$


``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(ATOdf_matchsomatic_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                                         Cancer_Label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = Cancer_Label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Adrenal cortical",
                                              "Adrenocortical",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       ATOdf_matchgermline_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                                         match_label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = match_label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("\\,.*",
                                              "",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Soft tissue sarcoma",
                                              "Soft tissues",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic")) %>% 
  mutate(BayesDel = as.numeric(BayesDel)) %>% 
  mutate(REVEL = as.numeric(REVEL))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  as_gt()
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Cancer,
                  Dataset,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
                                             levels = sort(unique(df_for_gt$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
                                   Sex, 
                                   Cancer_Label)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis",
                              Cancer_Label ~ "Cancer")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
chisq <- stats::chisq.test(as.matrix((ATOchisq_df %>% 
                                        subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                           "OTHER")) %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Cancer_Label, 
                                                        ATO)) %>% 
                                        table())
                                     ))

# Contibution in percentage (%)
contrib <- 100*chisq$residuals^2/chisq$statistic

corrplot::corrplot(chisq$residuals, 
                   is.corr = FALSE,
                   tl.col = "black", # label colors
                   cl.cex = 1, # legend font size
                   cl.ratio = 0.75, # legend scale width
                   tl.srt = 45, # rotate top labels
                   cl.align.text = "l") # align numbers to side of legend
```

<img src="figures/corrplot-resid-ATO-vs-cancers-1.svg" width="100%" height="100%" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

$~$


``` r
corrplot::corrplot(contrib, 
                   is.corr = FALSE,
                   tl.col = "black", # label colors
                   cl.cex = 1, # legend font size
                   cl.ratio = 0.75, # legend scale width
                   tl.srt = 45, # rotate top labels
                   col = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(200), # color of legend
                   cl.align.text = "l") # align numbers to side of legend
```

<img src="figures/corrplot-contrib-ATO-vs-cancers-1.svg" width="100%" height="100%" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

``` r
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(cancer_freq_pt_type ~ "Cancer frequency"),
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df_sole_mult_none %>%
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Age,
                  type)) %>%
  mutate(type = relevel(factor(type),
                        ref = "sole")) %>% 
  tbl_strata(strata = type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  Cancer_Label)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                   Sex,
                   Cancer_Label)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t
```

``` r
           file = paste0(fig_path, 
                         "sole-all-ATO-vs-age.png"),
           vwidth = 1800,

```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Sex)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- breakdown_forATO %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  subset(cancer_freq_pt_type %in% c("multiple", 
                                    "none")) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  ATO)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- breakdown_forATO %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  ATO)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
contingency_germ_som_ATO_gridprep <- condformat(contingency_germ_som_ATO) %>%
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  rule_text_bold(Total,
                 expression = Total > 0) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

contingency_germ_som_ATO_grid <- grid.arrange(contingency_germ_som_ATO_gridprep,
                                              top = textGrob("Contingency Table of Individuals with Selected Germline vs Somatic Mutations in TP53 and Cancer",
                                                             hjust = 0.5,
                                                             gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

# **Drawing Sole vs Multiple Pt Ages of Diagnosis Boxplots** {#solevsmultagesboxplots}

$~$


``` r
# create dataframe for boxplots with stats of sole pts vs mult pts first ages of dx to see if mult have cancers earlier
sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df <- rbind(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                        Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                        Sex,
                                                        Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                        distinct() %>% 
                                        transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                                                                   nrow(.),
                                                                   " individuals)")),
                                      origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                        Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                        Sex,
                                                        Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                        distinct() %>% 
                                        transform(Patient = paste0("First of multiple cancers (",
                                                                   nrow(.),
                                                                   " individuals)")))

sole_mult_none_ages_boxplot_df <- full_join(breakdown %>% subset(Unaffected == "true") %>% 
                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                              Age,
                                                              Sex,
                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                              mutate(Cancer_Label = ifelse(Cancer_Label != "OTHER", 
                                                                           Cancer_Label, 
                                                                           "No cancer")) %>% 
                                              distinct() %>% 
                                              mutate(Patient = paste0("No cancer (",
                                                                      nrow(.),
                                                                      " individuals)")),
                                            sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df %>% 
                                              dplyr::rename(Age = Age_at_diagnosis) %>% 
                                              distinct())
```

``` r
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter

# draw boxplots with stats of sole vs mult vs none first cancer ages or followup
sole_mult_none_ages_of_dx_followup_allpts_boxplot <- ggplot(sole_mult_none_ages_boxplot_df %>%
                                                              mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                                            Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                                            TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
                                                              mutate(Patient = gsub(" \\(.*", "", Patient)) 
                                                            #%>% 
                                                            # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                            #                    "OTHER"))
                                                            ,
                                                            aes(y = Age,
                                                                x = # Patient
                                                                  relevel(as.factor(Patient),
                                                                          ref = "One cancer")
                                                            )
) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
    stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                       label.y = 142) + # Add global p-value
    geom_pwc(method = "dunn_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons for Kruskal Wallis does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise Dunn with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.3, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p.adj.signif") + # to just show stars for significance
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off"
                  # , # prevent y-axis extending when brackets added so brackets drawn outside plot
                  # ylim = c(0, 100)
                  ) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73", "black", "#0072B2","slategray", "purple"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7
                     # ,
                     # limits = c(0, 150)
                     ) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed or at last follow up (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses or last follow up \nin Individuals with Cancer") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", color = "black",
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
  facet_wrap2(. ~ relevel(as.factor(type), ref = "sole"),
              ncol = 3,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x") + # show internal axes but without x labels
    geom_pwc(method = "wilcox_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise wilcox with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.5, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.05, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             #hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p = {p.adj}") + # to just show stars for significance
  geom_jitter(aes(color = ATO),
              width = 0.25,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.45,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(#"maroon",
                                "#0072B2", "darkgray" #, "#D55E00"
                                #,"#009E73", "black", "slategray", "purple"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #
  ),
  name = "ATO-rescuable") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 150)
                     ) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed or \nat last follow up (years)") +
  xlab("ATO-rescuable") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses or last follow up in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(10,10,10,10, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "lines"),
        #panel.spacing.y = unit(-10, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,35, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
# would be better to use GLM df to add all mutation clusters to cox model and just use sole patients
curvedf <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forGLM %>% 
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                         1,
                         0)) %>% 
  # transform(Cancer_vs_mut_cluster_coxph = dplyr::case_when(Cancer_vs_mut_cluster %in% c(1, 6) ~ "clusters 1 and 6",
  #                                                          Cancer_vs_mut_cluster %in% c(4, 5) ~ "clusters 4 and 5",
  #                                                          TRUE ~ paste0("cluster ",
  #                                                       Cancer_vs_mut_cluster))) %>%
  # #
```
