``` r
  # #             ifelse(Cancer_vs_mut_cluster %in% c(1, 6),
  # #                                                "clusters 1 and 6",
  # #                                                paste0("cluster ", 
  # #                                                       Cancer_vs_mut_cluster))) %>% # combine smaller clusters to prevent infinite axes
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  ACC,
                  Cancer_vs_mut_cluster,
                  # Cancer_vs_mut_cluster_coxph,
                  Age_vs_mut_cluster,
                  Sex_vs_mut_cluster,
                  Sex,
                  Age_stratum,
                  Population,
                  Region,
                  SIFTClass,
                  DNE_LOFclass,
                  Effect,
                  Domain,
                  Residue_function,
                  Rescuable
  )) %>%
  distinct()

# df for Kaplan-Meier survival of certain muts i.e. age for follow up, death noted, specific muts examined
KMdf <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>%
  subset(ProtDescription %in% c("R248Q",
                                "G245S",
                                "R248W")) %>%
  mutate(Dead_KM = ifelse(Dead == "true",
                          1,
                          0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Dead, 
                  Dead_KM,
                  # Age, # at follow up but not annotated for all patients
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  # Age_dx_follow,
                  ProtDescription,
  )) %>%
  mutate_at(c('ProtDescription'),
            as.factor) %>%
  distinct() 

KMdf$ProtDescription <- relevel(KMdf$ProtDescription,
                                ref = "R248Q")


# want to now see that if specific ACC-enriched mutations but did not have ACC first, how likely are they to get ACC at some point? thus, retain age of last cancer dx in mult pts, 
curvedf_mult <- origdbmultcancer %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  Sex,
                  Short_topo,
                  ProtDescription,
                  cancer_incidence)) %>% 
  transform(ACCfirst = ifelse(cancer_incidence == 1 & Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                              "ACC-first",
                              "Other-first")) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(ACCfirst = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$ACCfirst == "ACC-first"),
                                                      "Individual_code"]),
                              "ACC-first",
                              ACCfirst)) %>% 
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                         1,
                         0)) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$ACC == 1),
                                                 "Individual_code"]),
                         1,
                         ACC)) %>% 
  transform(Mutation = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                     "P152L",
                                                     "R158H"),
                              "T125T, P152L, R158H",
                              "Other-mut")) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(Mutation = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$Mutation == "T125T, P152L, R158H"),
                                                      "Individual_code"]),
                              "T125T, P152L, R158H",
                              Mutation)) %>% 
  group_by(Individual_code) %>% # get latest cancer for each pt rows only
  slice(which.max(cancer_incidence)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                  ACC,
                  Mutation,
                  Sex,
                  ACCfirst)) %>%
  mutate_at(c('Mutation',
              'Sex',
              'ACCfirst'),
            as.factor)
```

``` r
# since T125T, P152L, and R158H lead to a higher risk to develop ACC, want to see if they also associate with earlier age of dx for ACC
t <- tbl_summary(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                   subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
                   mutate(keymuts_or_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                                         "P152L",
                                                                         "R158H"),
                                                  "yes",
                                                  "no")) %>% 
                   distinct() %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                                   keymuts_or_not)), 
                 by = keymuts_or_not,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")
  #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
  ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
# define df for plot
df_cluster_age_plot <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
  mutate(keymuts_or_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                        "P152L",
                                                        "R158H"),
                                 "T125T, P152L, or R158H",
                                 "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                  keymuts_or_not,
                  Sex))

# plot
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter
ACC_sole_clustermuts_vs_age_boxplot <- ggplot(df_cluster_age_plot,
                                              aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                  x = relevel(as.factor(keymuts_or_not), 
                                                              ref = "T125T, P152L, or R158H"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon", 
                                "#0072B2"), 
                     labels = c("F" = "Female",
                                "M" = "Male"),
                     name = "Sex") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 60)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("p53 mutant") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnoses in Individuals with ACC") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
ACC_sole_clustermuts_vs_age_boxplot
```

``` r
# forest plot of Cox proportional hazard model of predictors tested in time to event
# install this fork to survminer to allow very large or small HR and CIs to plot
detach("package:survminer", unload = TRUE)
remotes::install_github("rschauner/survminer")
library(survminer)

# change function to allow proper plotting
# trace(ggforest, edit = TRUE) and copy and paste current function code to remove Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , var, with = FALSE) : unused argument (with = FALSE)
ggforest2 <- function (model, data = NULL, main = "Hazard ratio", cpositions = c(0.02, 
                                                                                 0.22, 0.4), fontsize = 0.7, refLabel = "reference", noDigits = 2) 
{
  conf.high <- conf.low <- estimate <- NULL
  stopifnot(inherits(model, "coxph"))
  data <- survminer:::.get_data(model, data = data)
  terms <- attr(model$terms, "dataClasses")[-1]
  coef <- as.data.frame(broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE))
  gmodel <- broom::glance(model)
  allTerms <- lapply(seq_along(terms), function(i) {
    var <- names(terms)[i]
    if (terms[i] %in% c("factor", "character")) {
      adf <- as.data.frame(table(data[, var])) # removed with = FALSE here
      cbind(var = var, adf, pos = 1:nrow(adf))
    }
    else if (terms[i] == "numeric") {
      data.frame(var = var, Var1 = "", Freq = nrow(data), 
                 pos = 1)
    }
    else {
      vars <- grep(paste0("^", var, "*."), coef$term, 
                   value = TRUE)
      data.frame(var = vars, Var1 = "", Freq = nrow(data), 
                 pos = seq_along(vars))
    }
  })
  allTermsDF <- do.call(rbind, allTerms)
  colnames(allTermsDF) <- c("var", "level", "N", "pos")
  inds <- apply(allTermsDF[, 1:2], 1, paste0, collapse = "")
  rownames(coef) <- gsub(coef$term, pattern = "`", replacement = "")
  toShow <- cbind(allTermsDF, coef[inds, ])[, c("var", "level", 
                                                "N", "p.value", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high", 
                                                "pos")]
  toShowExp <- toShow[, 5:7]
  toShowExp[is.na(toShowExp)] <- 0
  toShowExp <- format(exp(toShowExp), digits = noDigits)
  toShowExpClean <- data.frame(toShow, pvalue = signif(toShow[, 
                                                              4], noDigits + 1), toShowExp)
  toShowExpClean$stars <- paste0(round(toShowExpClean$p.value, 
                                       noDigits + 1), " ", ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 
                                                                    0.05, "*", ""), ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.01, 
                                                                                           "*", ""), ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.001, "*", 
                                                                                                            ""))
  toShowExpClean$ci <- paste0("(", toShowExpClean[, "conf.low.1"], 
                              " - ", toShowExpClean[, "conf.high.1"], ")")
  toShowExpClean$estimate.1[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- refLabel
  toShowExpClean$stars[which(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.001)] <- "<0.001 ***"
  toShowExpClean$stars[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$ci[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$estimate[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- 0
  toShowExpClean$var <- as.character(toShowExpClean$var)
  toShowExpClean$var[duplicated(toShowExpClean$var)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$N <- paste0("(N=", toShowExpClean$N, ")")
  toShowExpClean <- toShowExpClean[nrow(toShowExpClean):1, 
  ]
  ci_h <- toShowExpClean$conf.high[is.finite(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.high.1))]
  ci_l <- toShowExpClean$conf.low[!near(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.low.1), 
                                        0)]
  toShowExpClean$conf.high[is.infinite(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.high.1))] <- max(ci_h, 
                                                                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  toShowExpClean$conf.low[near(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.low.1), 
                               0)] <- min(ci_l, na.rm = TRUE)
  rangeb <- range(toShowExpClean$conf.low, toShowExpClean$conf.high, 
                  na.rm = TRUE)
  breaks <- axisTicks(rangeb/2, log = TRUE, nint = 7)
  rangeplot <- rangeb
  rangeplot[1] <- rangeplot[1] - diff(rangeb)
  rangeplot[2] <- rangeplot[2] + 0.15 * diff(rangeb)
  width <- diff(rangeplot)
  y_variable <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[1] * width
  y_nlevel <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[2] * width
  y_cistring <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[3] * width
  y_stars <- rangeb[2]
  x_annotate <- seq_len(nrow(toShowExpClean))
  annot_size_mm <- fontsize * as.numeric(grid::convertX(unit(theme_get()$text$size, 
                                                             "pt"), "mm"))
  p <- ggplot(toShowExpClean, aes(seq_along(var), exp(estimate))) + 
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = seq_along(var) - 0.5, xmax = seq_along(var) + 
                    0.5, ymin = exp(rangeplot[1]), ymax = exp(rangeplot[2]), 
                  fill = ordered(seq_along(var)%%2 + 1))) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFFFFF33", 
                                                                                         "#00000033"), guide = "none") + geom_point(pch = 15, 
                                                                                                                                    size = 4) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp(conf.low), 
                                                                                                                                                                  ymax = exp(conf.high)), width = 0.15) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     linetype = 3) + coord_flip(ylim = exp(rangeplot)) + 
    ggtitle(main) + scale_y_log10(name = "", labels = sprintf("%g", 
                                                              breaks), expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = breaks) + 
    theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), 
                       panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), 
                       panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), 
                       legend.position = "none", 
                       panel.border = element_blank(), 
                       axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
                       axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
                       axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                                size = 14), 
                       plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                                 size = 18,
                                                 face = "bold",
                                                 color = "black")) + 
    xlab("") + annotate(geom = "text", x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_variable), 
                        label = toShowExpClean$var, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, 
                        size = annot_size_mm) + annotate(geom = "text", x = x_annotate, 
                                                         y = exp(y_nlevel), hjust = 0, label = toShowExpClean$level, 
                                                         vjust = -0.1, size = annot_size_mm) + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                                                                        x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_nlevel), label = toShowExpClean$N, 
                                                                                                        fontface = "italic", hjust = 0, vjust = ifelse(toShowExpClean$level == 
                                                                                                                                                         "", 0.5, 1.1), size = annot_size_mm) + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                                                                                                                                                                         x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_cistring), label = toShowExpClean$estimate.1, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                         size = annot_size_mm, vjust = ifelse(toShowExpClean$estimate.1 == 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                "reference", 0.5, -0.1)) + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_cistring), label = toShowExpClean$ci, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    size = annot_size_mm, vjust = 1.1, fontface = "italic") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_stars), 
             label = toShowExpClean$stars, size = annot_size_mm, 
             hjust = -0.2, fontface = "italic") + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                           x = 0.5, y = exp(y_variable), label = paste0("# Events: ", 
                                                                                                        gmodel$nevent, "; Global p-value (Log-Rank): ", 
                                                                                                        format.pval(gmodel$p.value.log, eps = ".001"), " \nAIC: ", 
                                                                                                        round(gmodel$AIC, 2), "; Concordance Index: ", round(gmodel$concordance, 
                                                                                                                                                             2)), size = annot_size_mm, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, 
                                                           fontface = "italic")
  gt <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p))
  gt$layout$clip[gt$layout$name == "panel"] <- "off"
  ggpubr::as_ggplot(gt)
}
```

# **Drawing Alluvial Plots** {#alluvialplots .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

As another way to represent data from the clustered heatmaps, and to get a sense of how the proportions "flow" between the annotations, i.e. key information of the data, I have created alluvial plots as below. These alluvial plots are plotted both for mutation types and positions, as well as colored by tissue, germ layer, age, sex, or p53 domain.

At the end of the page are references for all packages and papers referenced, in APA style. The following code allows for the automatic compilation of package references, while papers are manually inputted into a germlinepapers.bib file. Papers are added in the Visual editor by DOI and included as in-text citations.

$~$


``` r
knitr::write_bib(c(.packages()), 
                 file = paste0(table_path, "germlinepkgs.bib"))
```
